intro: This quest bridges an investigation from Brill to the Undercity, tasking an adventurer with delivering a recovered heirloom ring to a widower named Raleigh. Found on a woman's stolen corpse bound for Fenris Isle, the jewelry points to a tragedy among Lordaeron's former inhabitants. Delivering it sets into motion a dark pursuit of vengeance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity. If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.
Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this ring was my wife's. Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times. I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.
Such feelings have long since grown cold within me. But desire does still burn in my dead heart, friend.
